title: World-axis relational DP with explicit wall faces
coverage_gap: D20 contains ten LL and ten HH object_x/goal_x pairs and no LH or HL. Independent lateral reach and carry errors are not covered by absolute-coordinate correlation. Larger E offsets also make a support-standardized near-zero goal-minus-object x channel unreliable.
reusable_regularity: Make object-minus-hand, goal-minus-object and goal-minus-hand explicit in common physical units, rather than asking a network to subtract independently standardized coordinates. Use fixed metre scales without support-variance amplification or feature clipping. Signed box-face distances expose above/beside/before-wall configurations; all decisions and the complete action sequence are still learned by the single common DP. Canonicalizing quaternion sign preserves physical rotation.
dependencies_preserved: World axes and gravity remain distinguished; this is not an unjustified obstacle-free or rotation-invariant policy.
Wall center, all three half sizes, and hand/object/goal relative to the wall recover their complete world positions. Extra absolute z channels expose the tabletop/vertical relation.

Current and native previous hand/object positions are recoverable from positions plus one-step differences. Both gripper apertures and both object quaternions remain available in each of the two causal observations.
Object2 channels are omitted only because task_materials declares object2_present=false and the read support rows show absent zeros. No active physical entity is dropped.

evidence_refs.detail: Exact pick-place-wall__N20__rep0 bundle: 20 episodes, no dev/test states.
LL/HH training, crossed C and four extrapolation cells; runtime pose, wall and native action definitions.
cell_counts and demo_00 through demo_05 entries read: x motion much smaller than y/z; wall center (0.1,0.75,0.06), half size (0.12,0.01,0.06).
Initial object, hand, wall and far-side goal are distinct entities.
Lifted object on the hand side of the wall.
Transport toward the goal beyond the wall.
Descending hand, still-tabletop object and closing aperture motivate explicit hand-object geometry and motion.
Carried object remains below the hand, above wall top; lateral wall-boundary dependence is retained.

expected_failure_signature: If explicit relations alone do not overcome the narrow lateral training actions, crossed layouts should show accurate grasp followed by insufficient x transfer toward the independent goal. If phase ambiguity is the bottleneck, it should instead hesitate or switch lift/transport incorrectly near contact, despite correct wall-relative geometry. No success improvement is claimed in advance.

required_runtime_fields.semantics: All from shared deployment observations, no time, stage oracle, reward or future fields.

action_frame_semantics: Identity encode/decode of [world_dx,world_dy,world_dz,gripper]. Translation retains 0.01 m/native unit; gripper is untouched and is not a vector. Only host clips the native cube and executes four of sixteen actions.
support_statistics: No candidate support fitting. Fixed dimensional scales are representation hyperparameters, not fitted statistics. Host common normalization and action epsilon loss remain unchanged; this representation reads raw causal context.
change_summary: Initial independent design: deterministic 57-channel relational conditioning, one untouched common action4 DP, no auxiliary head, no action transform. No performance feedback used and no pre-check structural edits.
